change_summary.intent: Bind native frozen module execution to an operator-retained source-graph pin before evaluation.

changed_signatures: Optional source pin in serialized RuntimeConfig; explicit constructors initialize None

operational_impact.operator_notes: Omitting the pin preserves existing behavior. A supplied pin must be canonical and requires frozen execution. The existing resolver consumes exactly the capture it validates. This is operator-selected integrity, not registry-signed provenance or an authority grant.
required_actions: Retain the reviewed graph hash outside guest-writable source and explicitly approve a new pin after intended source or resolution changes.
operational_impact.rollout_notes: Current-source native tests and required Rust checks are pending. GitHub Actions is disabled; no hosted CI, benchmark, production rollout, rollback rehearsal or quantitative risk reduction is claimed. The complete no-contract gate must remain non-passing until its actual evidence obligations are satisfied.

risk_delta.rationale: Adds an opt-in integrity boundary without claiming a measured reduction in production compromise risk. Full artifact-authority and capability-envelope integration remains open.

compatibility.details: Default serialized configs omit the new optional field. Explicit pins require updated source builds; CLI takes precedence over TOML. Resource, capability, trust, containment and parser restrictions continue to apply.
